summary: Sheriff's deputies booked a man on two drug-possession charges Sunday and arrested a woman on a false-identity charge minutes before a separate hindering-prosecution arrest. The jail roster shows nine criminal bookings dated Nov. 1 and one so far on Nov. 2; Daphne and Fairhope police logged nine arrest entries for Nov. 1 that were not posted Sunday.

entries.title: Failure to appear arrest: Andrew James Crenshaw Jr
body: Andrew James Crenshaw Jr., 38, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 12:39 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, according to the jail roster — the only criminal booking in the jail's last-24-hours list when it was read.
He was booked on a charge of failure to appear on a felony — missing a required court date in a felony case. The roster does not name the underlying case. He was in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Drug possession arrest: Jeffery Thomas Whaley
body: Jeffery Thomas Whaley, 55, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 11:19 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 1, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on two counts of possession of dangerous drugs — possessing a controlled substance without a prescription. He was in custody when the roster was read. The sheriff's office has not posted details of the arrest.

entries.title: False identity and hindering arrests: Brandy Leanne Price Nixon, Paul Michael Jones
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Brandy Leanne Price Nixon, 44, at 4:15 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 1, on a charge of using a false identity to avoid arrest or hinder prosecution — giving police a false name. She was in custody when the roster was read.

Fifteen minutes later, at 4:30 a.m., deputies arrested Paul Michael Jones, 48, on a charge of second-degree hindering prosecution — helping someone avoid arrest. He was released the same day. The roster does not say whether the two arrests are connected.

entries.title: Fleeing arrest: Zachary William Jones
body: Zachary William Jones, 35, was arrested by sheriff's deputies on Saturday, Oct. 31, and booked Sunday, Nov. 1, according to the jail roster.
He was booked on charges of attempting to elude a law enforcement officer — fleeing police after a signal to stop — and resisting arrest. He was in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Early Sunday arrests: three booked, all released
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Katera Amiyah Lashae Rankin, 24, at 1:20 a.m. and Jordy Armando Hernandez Chinchilla, 25, at 2:35 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 1, on charges of public intoxication, according to the jail roster.
Deputies arrested Charles Jared Yeend, 61, at 2:38 a.m. on charges of methamphetamine possession and first-offense drug paraphernalia. All three were released the same day.

entries.title: Animal cruelty arrest: John Robert Gilliam
body: John Robert Gilliam, 30, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 6:13 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 31, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on a charge of aggravated cruelty to animals — intentionally torturing or seriously injuring an animal. The roster shows him released the same day. The sheriff's office has not posted details of the arrest.

entries.title: Drug trafficking arrest: Javas Kamil Dade
body: Javas Kamil Dade, 29, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 2:30 a.m. Friday, Oct. 30, and booked into the county jail Saturday, Oct. 31, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on charges of drug trafficking — possessing or selling a quantity of drugs above the state's trafficking threshold — possession of dangerous drugs and first-offense drug paraphernalia. The roster does not name the drug. He was in custody when the roster was read Sunday morning.

entries.title: Public assistance fraud arrest: Luke Alexander Barber
body: Luke Alexander Barber, 24, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 3 p.m. Friday, Oct. 30, and booked Saturday, Oct. 31, according to the jail roster.
He was booked on a charge of public assistance fraud — obtaining government benefits by false statements. The roster shows him released Oct. 31.

entries.title: Family harassment arrests: Robert Maurice Gilliam, Melanie Leanne Thompson
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested two people on charges of harassment of a family or household member, according to the jail roster.

Robert Maurice Gilliam, 59, was arrested at 7:09 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 31. Melanie Leanne Thompson, 45, was arrested at 11:09 p.m. Friday, Oct. 30, and booked Oct. 31. Both were in custody when the roster was read Sunday morning.

entries.title: Drunk-driving and drug arrests: four booked Oct. 31
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Terrance Terrell Fields, 32, at 5 a.m. and Cole Leigh Hayward, 21, at 6 a.m. Saturday, Oct. 31, on charges of driving under the influence of alcohol; Fields was also booked on an open-container charge. Both were released the same day, according to the jail roster.

Robertsdale police arrested Cale Bernard Starr, 46, at 5:32 p.m. Friday, Oct. 30, on charges of methamphetamine possession and first-offense drug paraphernalia; he was booked Oct. 31 and was in custody when the roster was read. Gulf Shores police arrested Jessica Nicole Beckwith, 33, at 1:52 a.m. Oct. 31 on charges of possession of dangerous drugs and drug paraphernalia; she was released the same day.

entries.title: Cocaine and property-damage arrests: Patric Jordan Landrum, Freddie Demetrius James
body: Patric Jordan Landrum, 34, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 3:48 a.m. Saturday, Oct. 31, and booked on charges of cocaine possession and first-offense drug paraphernalia, according to the jail roster.

Freddie Demetrius James, 42, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 2:46 a.m. Friday, Oct. 30, and booked on charges of criminal mischief — damaging another person's property — and public intoxication. Landrum was released Oct. 31, according to the roster; James was in custody when it was read Sunday morning.
